items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Reed, Ola, his wife, and myself, Happy Donovan, Travis Tucker and a whole slew of TOBA favorites went from Dallas to Houston.

ctx.x: You were leaving Dallas with the...

Road show. All right. Leonard Reed, Ola, his wife, and myself, Happy Donovan, Travis Tucker and a whole slew of TOBA favorites went from Dallas to Houston. Now, I'd been playing shows, you know, amateur for Mrs. Moore, but this was my first professional show. And we rehearsed all day. I...Happy Donovan's wife, Clara, liked me and said that she would help me with the music and I said, "Well, I can't, you know, play by music, you know, there's jazz and stuff. So she says, "what you do, I'll hum," she said, "When a…

hear me and then you can start from that." And that's how I played the first week with that show, with her help. And when it came to the tempos, she says, "I'll stomp." She'd start...I could hear the tempo and I'd pick the tempo up from her and, you know, and her humming, and start the song. That's how I played my first week as a professional person on TOBA. And after the second week, while we were in Houston, Herschel Thomas--you know who he is?
